**Horsensklyngen** is a healthcare cluster (sundhedsklynge) operating within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] in Denmark [^src5]. It is one of the regional organizational units evaluated in the annual quality reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), which monitor the clinical treatment and outcomes of patients with [[atrieflimren]] across the Danish healthcare system.

Horsensklyngen is particularly notable for its strong performance in meeting national clinical quality standards. For Indikator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy in newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients, the cluster achieved a compliance rate of 92.9%, successfully fulfilling the required standard [^src1]. Its performance is consistently tracked across multiple treatment coverage periods, including 1-year and 2-year anticoagulation treatment coverage [^src2], as well as 5-year treatment coverage [^src3]. 

In broader quality assessments, Horsensklyngen stands out as a top performer. According to the RKKP's evaluation of [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]], the variation in goal fulfillment among Danish health clusters ranged from 52.9% in [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] to a high of 87.9% in Horsensklyngen [^src8]. The cluster's patient outcomes are also closely monitored for adverse events and complications, including the incidence of ischemic apoplexia ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) [^src4], severe bleeding within one year of diagnosis [^src6], and the development of heart failure [^src6]. Furthermore, long-term epidemiological metrics such as mortality and heart failure development in prevalent patients are routinely benchmarked at the cluster level [^src7]. Through this comprehensive tracking, Horsensklyngen serves as a key benchmark for high-quality cardiovascular care and regional quality improvement in Denmark.
